UPDATE companies c SET tin = NULL WHERE c.tin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.tin) <> '' AND c.id NOT IN ( SELECT keep_id FROM ( SELECT MIN(id) AS keep_id FROM companies WHERE tin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(tin) <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(tin) ) kept );
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_companies_tin ON companies (tin) WHERE tin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(tin) <> '';
